title: A Small Garden at School
author: 苏打阅读编辑部
introZh: 一个校园角落如何变成花园，又如何教会学生合作与负责。
paragraphs: At the start of autumn, Class 2 found a dusty corner behind their school library. The ground was hard, and nothing grew there. Their teacher, Ms. Lin, asked the class to turn it into a small garden. Every student chose a job, from carrying water to making signs.

At first, the students argued about where to put the plants. Tom wanted tall flowers in the middle, but Amy said they would block the sunlight. The class tested two plans for a week and watched which plants grew well. In the end, they put short vegetables in the sunniest place and moved the flowers to the edge.

By winter, the corner had become a favorite place for quiet reading and friendly talks. The garden did not just teach the students about plants. It also showed them that a shared space grows best when everyone listens, tries ideas, and takes responsibility.
